$comment: YO-30: text is laid out per grapheme CLUSTER (UAX #29 extended), never per code point. (1) Font fallback: a cluster the primary face cannot shape whole (Nunito has no U+0329 COMBINING VERTICAL LINE BELOW) shapes whole in the first fallback face that covers every character of it, so a combining mark attaches to its base (browsers, CoreText, minikin do this; gpui falls back per character and eui-gpui cuts its runs per cluster, crates/eui-gpui/src/fallback.rs). `attach` = the clusters whose marks must paint ON their base: same face as the base, inside the base's advance (never a free-standing glyph after it). (2) CSS `letter-spacing` follows clusters: `tracked` = how many times `letterSpacing` is added (a mark adds none; bidi controls none). Hand-written; src/text-clusters.ts is the reference, every renderer replays it (eui-gpui tests/text_clusters.rs with the conformance fonts, SwiftUI Round2Suites, Compose Round2Suites).

cases.name: a bidi mark takes no letter-spacing
